mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative equity sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contractions (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing output decline signals reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% annualized) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances when GDPC1 > 0.5% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During low but rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.05% and 3-month change > 0.01%), the market anticipates imminent tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.05% and rising, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
